statement: The CISA KEV catalog carries at least one entry whose vendorProject or product field names VeloCloud or SD-WAN Orchestrator, with a dateAdded value between 2026-09-23 and 2026-10-23.
resolution: TRUE if the CISA KEV catalog JSON contains a record whose vendorProject or product names VeloCloud or SD-WAN Orchestrator with dateAdded between 2026-09-23 and 2026-10-23 inclusive; otherwise FALSE.
failure_condition: No KEV record naming VeloCloud or SD-WAN Orchestrator carries a dateAdded inside the window.

statement: The CISA KEV catalog carries at least one entry with vendorProject D-Link and a dateAdded value between 2026-09-23 and 2026-12-15.
resolution: TRUE if the CISA KEV catalog JSON contains a record with vendorProject D-Link and dateAdded between 2026-09-23 and 2026-12-15 inclusive; otherwise FALSE.
failure_condition: No D-Link record in the KEV catalog carries a dateAdded inside the window.

statement: The S&P 500 sets a new all-time closing high on at least one session between 2026-09-23 and 2026-10-30. Reference: 7,764.88 close on the packet date, up 2.36 percent.
resolution: TRUE if S&P 500 daily close data show a close above the all-time closing high standing on 2026-09-22, on any session from 2026-09-23 through 2026-10-30; otherwise FALSE.
failure_condition: Every S&P 500 close inside the window sits at or below the all-time closing high that stood on 2026-09-22.

statement: Front-month Brent crude settles at or above 120.00 US dollars a barrel on at least one trading day between 2026-09-23 and 2026-12-31. Reference: 100.03 on the packet date.
resolution: TRUE if ICE front-month Brent settlement data show a settlement at or above 120.00 on any trading day from 2026-09-23 through 2026-12-31; otherwise FALSE.
failure_condition: Every ICE front-month Brent settlement inside the window prints below 120.00.

statement: Front-month WTI crude settles below 75.00 US dollars a barrel on at least one trading day between 2026-09-23 and 2026-11-30. Reference: 91.16 on the packet date, down 10.55 percent.
resolution: TRUE if NYMEX front-month WTI settlement data show a settlement below 75.00 on any trading day from 2026-09-23 through 2026-11-30; otherwise FALSE.
failure_condition: No NYMEX front-month WTI settlement inside the window prints below 75.00.

statement: FRED series DGS10 prints at or above 5.25 percent on at least one business day between 2026-09-23 and 2026-12-31. Reference: 4.96 percent on the packet date.
resolution: TRUE if FRED series DGS10 carries a value at or above 5.25 for any business day from 2026-09-23 through 2026-12-31; otherwise FALSE.
failure_condition: Every DGS10 observation inside the window sits below 5.25.

statement: Russia and Ukraine both publicly confirm a mutual halt on strikes against each other's energy infrastructure, announced between 2026-09-23 and 2026-12-18.
resolution: TRUE if statements from both the Russian and Ukrainian governments, reported by Reuters and AP, confirm a mutual moratorium on energy-infrastructure strikes announced inside the window; otherwise FALSE.
failure_condition: No mutual energy-strike moratorium is announced and confirmed by both governments inside the window.

statement: A single incident or single-day battle in Yemen kills 100 or more people, combatant or civilian, between 2026-09-23 and 2026-11-30.
resolution: TRUE if Reuters or AP, and Al Jazeera, both report a single Yemen incident or single-day battle inside the window with a death toll of 100 or more; otherwise FALSE.
failure_condition: No single Yemen incident inside the window reaches a reported toll of 100 or more deaths.

statement: Democrats win at least 218 seats in the US House of Representatives in the general election held 2026-11-03.
resolution: TRUE if AP race calls as of the deadline show Democrats winning 218 or more House seats in the 2026-11-03 general election; otherwise FALSE.
failure_condition: AP race calls at the deadline show Democrats holding fewer than 218 House seats.

statement: The NOAA CPC Oceanic Nino Index table carries a Sep-Oct-Nov 2026 seasonal value at or above plus 2.0 degrees Celsius.
resolution: TRUE if the NOAA CPC ONI table, fetched at the deadline, carries an SON 2026 value of 2.0 or higher; otherwise FALSE.
failure_condition: The CPC ONI table shows an SON 2026 value below 2.0 at the deadline.
